decisions.reason: The Opex assumption change does not alter capex values or shared-program capex treatment; the same message's separate capex instruction is already represented independently.
Selecting the program-level Opex range does not change the eight-site count, site configuration, or site-list source.
The source resolves an operating-cost assumption and does not change revenue streams, pricing assumptions, or revenue documentation.
The Opex range does not modify the capital stack, financing rate, debt-tranche structure, or refinancing trigger; the message's separate financing decision is already represented.
The Opex source decision does not alter the required CCA method, asset classes, tax shield, or equity-return treatment.
Although Opex is a model input, the source does not change the availability-payment sizing criteria or thresholds; the message's separate sizing instruction is already represented.
The selected Opex range and source do not change the model's CAD currency or 2026 price base year.
The broad requirement to annotate assumptions and use approved sources remains unchanged; the Opex-specific source selection is already owned by REQ_OPEX_MODELING.
Changing the Opex assumption may affect calculated scenario results but does not alter the required user-funded and PPP scenarios or their comparison.
The source resolves one Opex conflict without changing the general source-verification obligation, primary reference list, or directional role of the demand analysis.
The Opex input change does not modify the integrated three-statement structure or the required financial-engine rebuild.
The source changes an Opex assumption but does not change the requirement that worksheet formulas and links operate correctly.
